items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: When your reputation is no longer negative, we can talk requests again.
Your name has not been traveling well lately, so I will not risk workshop business on you.
Dwarves trade on trust, and right now that is exactly what you lack.
Stay away from my request board until people here trust you again.
I will not put my work at risk for your bad name. No requests today.
Get the dwarf quarter willing to nod at you first, then knock on my door.
If you truly want work, earn back the trust you lost first.
How is the fresh meat collection going? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
That is enough. Hand over the %s cuts. I will pay you and throw in the cooked stock I prepared.
How are the materials coming along? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
Good. Hand over the %s materials. These will keep today's work moving.
Still short on Blade Tiger tails? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
Good work. %s Blade Tiger tails will do nicely. Hand them over and the gold is yours.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: The butcher wants raw Blade Tiger meat for a new curing method. If the cuts are fresh enough, they can become travel rations fit for adventurers. Bring back a usable batch.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: Blade Tiger meat has firm fibers and makes excellent dried rations. Bring me %s raw cuts within %s.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Armorsaurus meat comes in heavy cuts and works well for soups and stews. The butcher wants to stock up today, so bring back a fresh batch.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: Armorsaurus meat makes the most filling broth around. Bring me %s raw cuts within %s.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Cattledeer beef always sells well, and the butcher wants the next batch ready before evening. Bring back a supply of decent cuts.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: Demand for Cattledeer beef is high and my stock is nearly gone. Bring me %s cuts within %s.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Giant Bat meat gains a distinct flavor once cured, and even taverns place orders for it now and then. The butcher is short on that ingredient, so refill the supply.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: A customer asked for Giant Bat meat and I am completely out. Bring me %s raw cuts within %s.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Knight Spider legs take effort to prepare, but the cooked result is better than most expect. The butcher wants a batch ready to test demand.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: Knight Spider legs look nasty, but some people swear by them once stewed. Bring me %s legs within %s.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Giant Ant legs yield more usable meat than they seem, and skewered cuts sell well enough. The butcher needs ingredients in a hurry.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: The kitchen wants to test a new roast today, and it needs proper ingredients first. Bring me %s Giant Ant legs within %s.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Serpent meat has a strong smell and must be processed while fresh. The butcher wants to turn it into a spice cure, so bring back enough to work with.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: Serpent meat spoils in flavor if it sits too long. Bring me %s raw cuts within %s while it is still fresh.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Spear Toro meat is tender and perfect for salted slices that keep well. The butcher is missing this main ingredient, so fill the order.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: Spear Toro meat is delicate, and a proper cure turns it into premium stock. Bring me %s raw cuts within %s.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Dried Spear Toro fins make a fine stock for soups, and both taverns and workshops have use for them. The butcher is short on material, so gather a batch.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: I want to simmer a few proper pots of fish broth, but I am out of Spear Toro fins. Bring me %s within %s.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Giant Ant carapace is hard, but intact pieces can be turned into knife handles and kitchen guards. The butcher wants material that can go straight to work.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: Do not underestimate carapace. Treated properly, it has its uses in a kitchen. Bring me %s intact Giant Ant carapaces within %s.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Knight Spider carapace has the toughness needed for small workshop tools once polished down. The butcher wants to restock supplies.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: Knight Spider carapace is both tough and resilient, perfect for refitting a few tools. Bring me %s within %s.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Armorsaurus scales are heat-resistant and sturdy, useful for replacing worn shields beside the stove. Gather a batch that is still fit to use.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: The guards by the stove are wearing out, and Armorsaurus scales are just right to replace them. Bring me %s within %s.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Armorsaurus shell is thick and dependable, and once flattened it makes a fine butchering board. The butcher wants to replace old equipment.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: Armorsaurus shell is thick enough to make a fine work board once shaped. Bring me %s within %s.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Serpent scales have a dense surface that suits finer kitchen fittings for trimming meat and fish. The butcher is short on this useful material.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: Serpent scales are just right for small fittings and fine work. Bring me %s within %s.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Centipede stingers need careful handling, but once processed they can aid preservative coatings and spice mixes. The butcher wants them for a new recipe.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: I am testing a new curing mix, and what I need most are Centipede stingers. Bring me %s within %s.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Ground Spider fangs can be used in special seasoning and preservation work. They are not used often, but shortages become a problem fast.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: Spider fangs are not needed every day, but once they are gone, everything slows down. Bring me %s within %s.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu: Blade Tiger tails carry tough sinew and make a rare dish the butcher only serves to trusted customers. The material is hard to source, and the reward reflects that.
items.lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil: Blade Tiger tails are not something you find every day. Bring me %s within %s and I will pay you in gold.
items.lang|tensura_guild|task.tensura_guild.cr: The guild has received word that a cultivator workshop urgently needs a Void Refinement Pill for a dangerous breakthrough attempt. Craft 1 Void Refinement Pill and submit it before the deadline.
A sealed alchemy request has arrived at the guild, demanding a Mystic Void Elixir refined to a stable state. Craft 1 Mystic Void Elixir and bring it back for delivery.
An advanced practitioner is paying handsomely for a Giant Spirit Pill strong enough to support a major cultivation stage. Craft 1 Giant Spirit Pill and submit it to the guild.
A top-tier workshop wants to inspect a Hihiirokane Bone Golem as a model for elite autonomous guardians. Craft 1 Hihiirokane Bone Golem and turn it in before the order is withdrawn.
A fortified estate is commissioning an Adamantite Bone Golem durable enough to stand as a permanent defender. Craft 1 Adamantite Bone Golem and return to submit it.
The guild needs a completed Orichalcum Bone Golem for a defensive evaluation contract. Craft 1 Orichalcum Bone Golem and bring it back on time.
A client from the workshop district has requested a Pure Magisteel Bone Golem to test advanced magical reinforcement methods. Craft 1 Pure Magisteel Bone Golem and submit it.
A local defense supplier is short on compact constructs and wants a Mithril Bone Golem ready for field trials. Craft 1 Mithril Bone Golem and bring it in.
The guild workshop wants a High Magisteel Bone Golem to compare durability against recent combat reports. Craft 1 High Magisteel Bone Golem and submit it.
Even lower-grade constructs are in demand when patrol routes need more bodies on watch. Craft 1 Low Magisteel Bone Golem and return it to the guild.
The transport network is missing a stable Warp Core, and the guild needs a fresh one forged before repairs can continue. Craft 1 Warp Core and submit it.
items.lang|tensura_guild|ftbquests.task.tensur: Complete one commission issued by a dwarf.
Complete one guild commission, optionally filtered by task rank.
Reach the configured amount of adventure EXP.
items.lang|tensura_guild|gamerule.applyTensura: Reduces commission currency and adventure experience rewards for low task success rates and blocks non-currency item rewards below 60%.
